pages.title: Gateway to the Spirit Realm
pages.text: This entry follows patchouli_static_entries.json#tianyuan_city, tianyuan_city.json, and region_cards/tianyuan.json. The tianyuan region is available in current world data, requires Deity Transformation, and uses tianyuan_anchor for travel.

pages.title: Current Data
pages.text: Tianyuan City has a 2.0 aura multiplier and the tags spirit_realm, frontier, and merit. Its joint human-demon defense, Spirit Realm passage, Wind-Thunder Vessel, and Earth Abyss permit broker remain guide context and future quest hooks.

pages.title: Merit and the Earth Abyss
pages.text: The text materials group merit_points, tianyuan_merit_path, spirit_realm_gate, wind_feather_raft, and diyuan_permit_broker under Tianyuan. The current build provides seeking_immortals:diyuan_permit and seeking_immortals:wind_feather_raft_ticket; server-side travel from Great Jin Central or Dajin to Tianyuan consumes one Wind Feather Raft Ticket, and Diyuan secret-realm entry consumes one Diyuan Permit. Merit exchange sources and quest checks remain future work.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: Real Tianyuan NPCs, merit exchange UI, patrol missions, broader cross-realm routes, Diyuan permit acquisition, Wind Feather ticket vendors, city-defense rewards, and FTB Quests chapters remain deferred. This page documents the shipped worldpack region, Diyuan Permit entry cost, Wind Feather Raft Ticket route, and source-material goals.
